sql.propToolPanel.getAllForCompany: select p.id, p.panel_name, p.company_id, p.archived from props.panel p where p.company_id = :companyId and p.archived is not true order by p.panel_name
sql.propToolPanel.update: update props.panel set panel_name = :panelName where id = :id
sql.propToolPanel.delete: update props.panel set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
